__reason: Every numeric column the migrations declare, classified once, by hand. `numeric(12,2)` is NOT a synonym for money: 23 of the columns below are quantities, rates and confidences, and giving any of them a currency is the first failure mode of a search-and-replace through this schema (PLAN-multi-currency-20260828 §1.1). The list is pinned the way scripts/i18n-baseline.json is pinned — a numeric column that appears in a migration and in neither list fails check:currency, so the next money column cannot be added quietly.

__carriers.own: the table carries its own `currency` column — a document or transaction head, a price list row, or a threshold (plan §2)
__carriers.inherits:<table>: no column of its own; the currency is the parent row's. A document is never printed in two currencies (plan §2)
__carriers.allocation: no currency of its own by design; the composite foreign keys make a cross-currency link unrepresentable rather than merely rejected (plan §4.1)

notMoney.organizations.vat_rate: a tax rate, not an amount
notMoney.invoice_lines.vat_rate: a tax rate, not an amount

__aggregatesReason: The 111 money aggregation sites that predate this work are rewritten in phase 2, not by this guard. From 0214 onward a new function that sums money and never says the word `currency` is the exact way the false total comes back, so it fails here.
